page: Vite plugin directory covering official, community, and Rolldown plugins. Official Vite plugins: @vitejs/plugin-vue (Vue 3 SFC support), @vitejs/plugin-vue-jsx (Vue 3 JSX via Babel), @vitejs/plugin-react (React Fast Refresh via Oxc Transformer), @vitejs/plugin-react-swc (SWC replaces Oxc dev, SWC+Oxc build with plugins, faster cold start/HMR big projects), @vitejs/plugin-rsc (React Server Components via Environment API, npm create vite --template rsc), @vitejs/plugin-legacy (legacy browser production support). Community plugins: Vite Plugin Registry published npm. Rolldown builtin plugins: used under hood, common use cases, Rolldown Builtin Plugins section. Rolldown/Rollup plugins: Vite plugins extend Rollup interface, Rolldown Plugin Compatibility section.
